description: In this article, I'll take another look at EVPN Route Controller, since additional features were added in VCF 9.1.1. Direct prefix routing and active/active mode are among the new features that have been introduced.
title: VCF 9.1.1 - DTGW & VNA: the route controller within me - Part 2

description: In this article, I’ll take another look at VPCs and the VNA. This time, the VNA acts as the route controller, and the VPC is connected via VXLAN/EVPN using Type 5 routes.
title: VCF 9.1 - DTGW & VNA: the route controller within me
